judge.reason: The revisit is decision-relevant: the 12-week review point has passed, and the new week-14 note reports the same routine but no new posture assessment. The candidate correctly says improvement cannot be judged from continued exercise or passive watch data, recommends repeating the same P1 photo protocol, and explains that the comparison could inform whether to continue the routine or discuss an adjustment. It does not claim the exercises caused improvement or repeat a previously surfaced insight.
